source: HL7 V2.5.1 LRI E6 Ballot, May 2026 draft for review (2026-03-17)
coverage_notices: Terminology membership is checked only for code sets completely enumerated in the pinned draft.
The validator does not claim membership validation for _NAACCR companion tables, the unresolved SPM-4 SNOMED CT subset, annual reportability lists, or the CAP eCP dictionary.
CAP eCP validation covers message structure and identifier, repeat, and parent-link syntax; it does not verify identifiers against CAP-controlled artifacts.
This draft-based validator is not a certification service and does not perform context-based or transport testing.

content.attribution: Registry content checks use the SEER API provided by the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results Program, National Cancer Institute.
coverage_notices: The optional check sends only the codes and reference identifiers listed before each run; it never sends the full message or direct identifiers.
The transmitted codes are sensitive coded clinical metadata. SEER and network operators can also observe the API account and source IP address.
Results are pinned to EOD 3.3, TNM 2.1, CS 02.05.50, and NAACCR 26; the SEER disease database and site-recode service are not version-pinned by the API.
Narrative extraction is conservative. Conflicting or unrecognized values are skipped instead of guessed.
Schema input checks cover only extracted fields with a published SEER value table. They do not perform complete cancer staging.

INPUT-001.expected: Provide one ER7 message without FHS/BHS wrappers.

LRI-11.expected: Declare legacy NG-FRU .3 or Common .22 + NG .13 + FRU .83.

LRI-NAACCR-PROFILE.expected: Declare LRI_NAACCR_Component OID ending .31 in MSH-21.

DRAFT-CONFLICT-01.expected: Apply literal LRI-11; table OID .25 is not accepted as its substitute.

STRUCTURE-001.expected: Use the constrained ORU_R01 segment order and cardinalities.

FIELD-R.expected: Populate every R field and applicable conditional field.

CARDINALITY-001.expected: Do not exceed NAACCR field or segment cardinality.

SETID-001.expected: Set IDs start at 1 and increase sequentially in their scope.

LRI-23.expected: ORC-2 equals OBR-2 in the order group when valued.

LRI-24.expected: ORC-3 equals OBR-3 in the order group.

LRI-25.expected: ORC-12 equals OBR-16 in the order group.

LRI-28.expected: FRU filler order numbers are unique across order groups.

LRI-33.expected: OBR-8 is equal to or later than OBR-7.

LRI-34.expected: OBR-1 is sequential across order groups.

STATUS-001.expected: OBR-25 matches the statuses in its OBX-11 fields.

DATE-001.expected: Use valid HL7 date/time syntax and preserve stated date relationships.

OBR4-001.expected: Use an applicable OBR-4 LOINC from Table 7.13 when the report kind is enumerated.

STYLE-001.expected: Use a recognized first-OBX report style declaration for synoptic reports.

STYLE-002.expected: Use the three ordered metadata OBXs with the stated LOINCs and datatypes.

NARRATIVE-001.expected: Use one complete OBX per narrative report or report section.

OBX4-001.expected: Populate a valid OBX-4 when repeated OBX-3 identifiers require disambiguation.

ECP-001.expected: Use full CAP eCP Ckey identifiers and CAPECP coding systems.

ECP-002.expected: Encode repeats as __n with CAPECP.RPT plus original IDs and sequential suffixes.

ECP-003.expected: Use +Ckey for parent links or a bare selected-LIR Ckey for LIR response links.

DEPRECATED-001.expected: Use the replacement LOINC identified by the draft.

LRI-NAACCR-01.expected: CNN.10 is valued when the principal result interpreter is sent.

LRI-NAACCR-02.expected: CNN.11 is NPI, MD, or ISO.

LRI-NAACCR-03.expected: EI_03.3 is a valid NPI when EI_03.4 is NPI.

LRI-NAACCR-04.expected: EI_03.3 starts with a 2-4 letter state/province prefix when EI_03.4 is MD.

LRI-NAACCR-05.expected: EI_03.3 is an ISO OID when EI_03.4 is ISO.

LRI-NAACCR-06.expected: HD_04.2 is a valid NPI when HD_04.3 is NPI.

LRI-NAACCR-07.expected: HD_04.2 starts with a 2-4 letter state/province prefix when HD_04.3 is MD.

LRI-NAACCR-08.expected: HD_04.2 is an ISO OID when HD_04.3 is ISO.

SPM9-001.expected: When SPM-9 uses SCT, use a laterality code enumerated in the draft.

CONTENT-EXTRACT-01.expected: Resolve conflicting content candidates before registry checks are run for that field.

CONTENT-SITE-01.expected: Use a primary-site code consistent with the recognized report template family.

CONTENT-COMBO-01.expected: Use a site and histology combination recognized by the pinned SEER staging algorithm.

CONTENT-COMBO-02.expected: Supply the applicable discriminator before schema-specific field checks are interpreted.

CONTENT-COMBO-03.expected: Use a staging schema consistent with the recognized report template family.

CONTENT-FIELD-01.expected: Use a behavior value present in the selected schema's published input table.

CONTENT-FIELD-02.expected: Provide staging inputs that the selected schema uses and does not default when those values are available in the report.

CONTENT-FIELD-03.expected: Use a grade value present in the selected schema's published grade table.

CONTENT-HEME-01.expected: Use a hematopoietic morphology recognized by the SEER disease database.

CONTENT-HEME-02.expected: Use the morphology only within the validity years published by the SEER disease database.

CONTENT-RECODE-01.expected: Review the SEER site-recode group as registry context.

CONTENT-RECODE-02.expected: Use a site-recode group consistent with the recognized report template family.

CONTENT-DICT-01.expected: Use a code present in the pinned NAACCR item's published allowed-code list.

CONTENT-MPH-01.expected: Review the SEER multiple-primary result for each extractable order-group pair.

CONTENT-API-01.expected: Retry with a usable SEER API key and network connection; local checks remain available.
